**Regulation to analyze:** NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 with NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 (OT), NIST CSWP 29 (Feb. 26, 2024); NIST SP 800-82r3 (Sep. 2023)
**Why:** No binding sector-wide cyber regulation exists for critical manufacturing; CSF 2.0 + SP 800-82r3 is the federal reference baseline for IT/OT. Where the manufacturer is a DoD supplier, substitute NIST SP 800-171 R2 / CMMC Level 2 as the binding target.
